title: Connecticut After-School Learning Grant
summary: Supports out-of-school-time tutoring and academic enrichment for Connecticut students in grades K-12.
eligibility: Must be an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) public charity
Must be located in Connecticut and serve Connecticut students
Program must serve students in grades K-12 outside the regular school day
Annual operating budget under $1,000,000
Must report student attendance and at least one academic outcome
questions: Describe your organization and the students you serve. (250 words)
Describe the after-school program this grant would support, including its schedule and staffing. (400 words)
What academic outcomes do you track, and what were your most recent results? (300 words)
How will you use the requested funds? (200 words)

summary: Supports reading programs for children from birth to age 8 and their caregivers.

title: Small Nonprofit Capacity Grant
summary: Capacity support for small organizations investing in staff, systems, training, or planning.
